title: Jazz @ Suns — Assist wrongly credited to Chris Paul, re-assigned to Mikal Bridges next day (Jan 24-25, 2022)
incident_summary: In the Jazz-Suns game of Jan 24, 2022, an assist was erroneously credited to Suns guard Chris Paul. After bettors flagged the error on social media, the NBA corrected the box score the next day (Jan 25): the assist was taken away from Paul and credited to Suns teammate Mikal Bridges. The game score/total was never in dispute — this is a non-scoring stat correction, included because it documents the league's post-game correction pipeline and same-week pattern (paired with the Jan 27-28 Edwards steal correction).
scoring_play: Unspecified assist play — quarter, clock, and teams' score at the time were not documented in the reviewed sources. Do not infer.
affected_player: Chris Paul (PHX) — assist removed; Mikal Bridges (PHX) — assist added

corrected_value.value: Assist taken from Paul, credited to Mikal Bridges

final_official.basis: Corrected official box score (ESPN). Game final score was never disputed and is out of scope for this record — not asserted here.

sources_disagreed: Game-night box score (Paul assist) vs. corrected box score (Bridges assist)

cause.detail: Suspected real-time attribution error by the in-game stat crew (wrong player credited for one assist). The league/NBA Operations updates only assists credited to the wrong player postgame (per the NBA email quoted by ESPN) — consistent with this fix. Exact crew-level cause undocumented.

timeline.event: Jazz @ Suns; assist erroneously credited to Chris Paul in the game-night box score.
After bettors voice frustration on social media, the NBA takes the assist from Paul and credits Mikal Bridges.

sources.confirms: Paul erroneously credited with an assist Jan 24; corrected to Bridges on Tuesday after bettor outcry; sportsbook settlement policies (BetMGM/DK settle on day-of box; FanDuel honored the Edwards correction).
Recap of the Paul-to-Bridges correction; Elias/NBA 'rare' characterization; NBA email policy (assists at arena statisticians' discretion; Operations only fixes wrong-player assists postgame).
